describes: `423` · `DELIVERY_CODE_LOCKED`. **Limit reached.** The fifth wrong delivery code locks it for this order and hands the order to support (`HANDOVER_CODE_LOCKED` on `admin:ops`). There is no photo fallback: support or an admin confirms the delivery with `overrideHandoverCode` (see `handover_override_delivery`).

error.message: Too many wrong codes. HalalGoes support is taking over this delivery; please stay with the order.
